      "source": [
        "def spearman_corr(x, y):\n",
        "    x = np.array(x)\n",
        "    y = np.array(y)\n",
        "\n",
        "    x_rank = x.argsort().argsort()\n",
        "    y_rank = y.argsort().argsort()\n",
        "\n",
        "    x_mean = x_rank.mean()\n",
        "    y_mean = y_rank.mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "    a = ((x_rank - x_mean) * (y_rank - y_mean)).sum()\n",
        "    b = np.sqrt(((x_rank - x_mean)**2).sum() * ((y_rank - y_mean)**2).sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "    return a / b"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ouc930we_zIV"
      },
      "execution_count": 47,
      "outputs": []

        "y_mean = np.mean(y_test) # считаем среднее значение целевой переменной\n",
        "ss_res = np.sum((y_test - y_pred_test) ** 2) # разница между реальными значениями и предсказаниями в квадртате\n",
        "ss_tot = np.sum((y_test - y_mean) ** 2) # разница между реальными значениями и их средним\n",
        "\n",
        "r2 = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot # сравниваем ошибку модели с разбросом данных\n",
        "\n",
        "print(r2)"

        "def business_metrics(y_true, y_pred):\n",
        "  error = abs(y_true - y_pred) / y_true\n",
        "  return (error <= 0.1).mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"LinearRegression:\", business_metrics(y_test, lr.predict(X_test)))\n",
        "print(\"Scaled LinearRegression:\", business_metrics(y_test, lr2.predict(test_x_scaler)))\n",
        "print(\"Lasso:\", business_metrics(y_test, lr_lasso.predict(test_x_scaler)))\n",
        "print(\"ElasticNet:\", business_metrics(y_test, best_elastic.predict(test_x_scaler)))\n",

      "source": [
        "def your_business_metrics(y_true, y_pred):\n",
        " error = abs(y_true - y_pred) / y_true\n",
        " penalty = 1\n",
        " penalty = penalty + (y_pred < y_true)\n",
        " score = (error * penalty <= 0.1).mean()\n",
        " return score\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"LinearRegression:\", your_business_metrics(y_test, lr.predict(X_test)))\n",
        "print(\"Scaled LinearRegression:\", your_business_metrics(y_test, lr2.predict(test_x_scaler)))\n",
        "print(\"Lasso:\", your_business_metrics(y_test, lr_lasso.predict(test_x_scaler)))\n",
        "print(\"ElasticNet:\", your_business_metrics(y_test, best_elastic.predict(test_x_scaler)))\n",
        "print(\"Ridge:\", your_business_metrics(y_test, best_ridge.predict(X_test_cat)))\n",
        "print(\"L0:\", your_business_metrics(y_test, lr_l0.predict(X_test_l0)))"
